assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded as I25.10.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the order.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to the symptomatic episodes.
The payer letter states that precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
Authorization status is missing from the case record.
The appeal is submitted with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.
The denial letter invites submission of supporting clinical documentation justifying medical necessity.
